title: Dark Chocolate Cherry Brownies
changes_from_base: Large-tray cocoa brownie studded with plumped dried cherries and a little almond flavour.
summary: A large tray of dark cocoa brownies studded with plumped dried cherries and a hint of almond.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cherries
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the large tin. Simmer the cherries with the 60 ml water in a small covered pan for 2 min, then leave covered for 10 min to plump. Stir in the almond flavouring.

steps.title: Chocolate
steps.text: Whisk the boiling water, chopped chocolate and cocoa together until smooth, then whisk in the melted butter and oil.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Add the eggs, yolks and vanilla, then the sugar and salt, whisking until glossy. Fold in the flour, then the cherries with any liquid left in the pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 30-35 min, until a cocktail stick comes out with a few sticky crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 1-2 h before lifting out and cutting into 24.

tips: Plumping the cherries keeps them soft and juicy.
Line the tin with overhanging paper for easy lifting.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
